How long have you been experiencing these difficulties conceiving and discomfort during sexual activity?

Do you notice any pain specifically during penetration or deep thrusting?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old female. The patient and her husband have been trying to conceive for 15 months without success. They are sexually active at least twice a week. The husband occasionally has difficulties maintaining an erection. The patient reports discomfort and pelvic floor muscle tension during attempted vaginal penetration. Diagnosed with body dysmorphic disorder three years ago. No family history of serious illness. She is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol. No medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Do you feel this pelvic pain is cyclical, perhaps worsening around the time of your period or ovulation? REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Normal uterus and adnexa with no evidence of fibroids or ovarian cysts.

speaker: Patient
text: he is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol. No medications. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Multiple sclerosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is incorrect; Multiple Sclerosis does not present with infertility and pain specifically during vaginal penetration. Given the pelvic floor tension and the ultrasound results, would you have any history of severe menstrual cramps or past gynecological surgeries? REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound: Please include detailed views of the ovaries and uterus.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Normal uterus and adnexa with no evidence of fibroids or ovarian cysts.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Dyspareunia secondary to pelvic floor myofascial pain syndrome.

I have ruled out structural causes like endometriosis or cysts on the ultrasound. Your history of BDD and the specific sensation of muscle tension suggests the pain is likely muscular rather than organic. I will recommend pelvic floor physical therapy and stress management techniques to address this.
